component: GPU-resident accepted count for native MTP/GDN rollback
modifications: Idea only; no Splash code copied. Splash's verifier writes the accepted draft count into a device buffer (DecodeTensor::AcceptedCount) that later kernels read.

Adapted to mlx2's compact GDN replay: a reconstruct-kernel variant derived by text replacement from the existing template kernel reads the accepted prefix from an int32 buffer per row (clamped to the tape) instead of a template parameter.
Generic GDN rollback replays the full verify width with a = b = -inf past each row's count (decay 1, beta 0), which equals the sliced replay bit for bit, as a one-graph per-row rollback.
Both are default-off: MLX_QWEN4_FUSED_GDN_DYNAMIC_ACCEPT (Flash-Next policy key fused_gdn_dynamic_accept) and MLX_LM_GDN_ARRAY_ACCEPT. The host-int fn(m) contract is unchanged.
validation: tests/test_gpu_accept_count.py (CPU references, dispatch contract, masked == sliced replay, one hybrid.* verify sync per greedy round)
scripts/bench_gpu_accept_count.py --device gpu (dynamic vs template kernel bit equality and timing; pending GPU queue)
